legend: We wish to construct an electricity generation and transmission network in a cluster of N%%ZSMJ0%% islands. To this end, we have calculated a cost p(x)%%ZSMJ1%% to (potentially) build a generating station on each island x%%ZSMJ2%%, as well as a cost c(x,y)%%ZSMJ3%% to build an energy transmission line between any two islands x%%ZSMJ4%% and y%%ZSMJ5%%. An island is connected to the grid if it has a generating station built on it, or if there is a sequence of power transmission lines connecting it to an island that has a generating station. Our goal is to connect all N%%ZSMJ6%% islands to the grid, minimizing the total network construction cost.
input: The first line of the input contains an integer N%%ZSMJ7%% which gives the number of islands in the cluster.

The next N%%ZSMJ8%% lines of the input are sequences of N%%ZSMJ9%% numbers that form an N%%ZSMJ10%%-by-N%%ZSMJ11%% array A%%ZSMJ12%%, such that each diagonal entry A[x,x]%%ZSMJ13%% corresponds to the cost p(x)%%ZSMJ14%% to build generating station on island x%%ZSMJ15%% (that is, ′A[x,x]=p(x)′%%ZSMJ16%%), while each non-diagonal entry A[x,y]%%ZSMJ17%% corresponds to the cost c(x,y)%%ZSMJ18%% to build an energy transmission line between two islands x%%ZSMJ19%% and y%%ZSMJ20%% (that is, ′A[x,y]=c(x,y)′%%ZSMJ21%%).
output: A single integer that gives the total construction cost of the network.
